findings.evidence: TauCeti/Topology/VectorBundle/DoubleDual.lean:87-91 has the same `c`/`j`/`toContinuousLinearEquiv` construction as the PR's helper. TauCeti/Analysis/Normed/Module/Dual/Reflexive/Basic.lean:72 has `surjective_inclusionInDoubleDual_of_finiteDimensional` over a general complete `𝕜`. mathlib LinearIsometry.lean:994 has `def ofSurjective`.
findings.fix: Add one public declaration over `[NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [CompleteSpace 𝕜] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 F]`, e.g. `(LinearIsometryEquiv.ofSurjective (inclusionInDoubleDualLi 𝕜) surjective_inclusionInDoubleDual_of_finiteDimensional).toContinuousLinearEquiv`, with an `_apply` lemma, next to `surjective_inclusionInDoubleDual_of_finiteDimensional`. Use it both in `bundleDoubleDualEquiv` and here.
findings.issue: The private `modelDoubleDualEquiv` (ℝ only) repeats, almost line for line, the inline `j'` that `bundleDoubleDualEquiv` builds over a general complete `𝕜`. The finite-dimensional bidual `≃L` therefore now exists twice, once at a narrower level than needed.

findings.evidence: In the `formEquiv` body every argument is `bundleLineDoubleDualEquiv (F := E [⋀^Fin k]→L[ℝ] ℝ) (fun y ↦ TangentSpace I y [⋀^Fin k]→L[ℝ] ℝ) (DensityBundle I M)`, `contMDiff_bundleLineDoubleDualEquiv`, `bundleLineDoubleDualEquiv_inFrame`/`_symm_inFrame` or `BundleTest.mapCLE`. All of these take `F`, `V` as parameters, and nothing in the proof depends on the alternating-map structure.
findings.fix: State the general result for any `[FiniteDimensional ℝ F]` smooth bundle `V`, e.g. `DualDensityTest.doubleDualEquiv : DualDensityTest I M (F →L[ℝ] ℝ) (fun x ↦ V x →L[ℝ] DensityBundle I M x) ≃L[ℝ] BundleTest I F V`, with its pairing and support lemmas. Then get `TestForm.formEquiv` and the `formDensityDoubleDualEquiv` formulas as one-line specializations.
findings.issue: `formEquiv` and the lemmas `apply_formEquiv_apply`, `formEquiv_symm_apply_apply`, `formEquiv_apply_eq_zero_iff` and the private `_apply_eq` lemmas are proved only for `V = Λᵏ T*M`. The proof uses only the general `bundleLineDoubleDualEquiv` (any `F`, `V`), its frame lemmas and `BundleTest.mapCLE`, so it holds for any finite-rank smooth bundle.

summary: The private `modelDoubleDualEquiv` is an ℝ-only copy of the finite-dimensional bidual `≃L` that main builds inline in `bundleDoubleDualEquiv`, and should be one public declaration over any complete field. `formEquiv` and its lemmas are proved only for `V = Λᵏ T*M`, but the proof never uses anything about forms and holds for any finite-rank smooth bundle `V`.
